findings.body: The no-session refusal at this line runs only for callers of `repo.route`. The unchanged `worker.work` path in `src/forge/worker.py:82-122` does not call it, so `forge work` can still start in a one-tool repo without a coordinating session. The separate WORK task owns that routing change.
